run_spec_test_suite: run the whole WebAssembly spec test suite against iwasm interpreter with AOT or SGX flags
run_single_test_case: run a single .wast test case file against the iwasm interpreter with target architecture
run_parallel_test_suite: run the entire spec test suite in parallel across all available CPU cores
run_aot_test_suite: run the spec test suite in ahead-of-time compilation mode with wamrc compiler
run_sgx_test_suite: run the spec test suite in SGX enclave environment with the iwasm SGX binary
